setup: Tested KA Box, BoxII_CoreBoard V2.0, LEP02_ComputeBoard V2, firmware 2.2.2.

console_access.label: proven
console_access.observation: The stock serial console started /bin/sh without a password prompt. The identity command returned uid=0(root) gid=0(root).

records.text: | Root uid=0; Linux 3.10.0-infotm armv7l; Hardware iMAPx910 | uart-identity.raw, uart-identity.txt | Executed console response; four CPU entries |
| ttyAMA3 at 115200, stock getty launches /bin/sh without a password prompt | uart-identity.txt, dbg-kmsg.txt, dbg-psinfo.json | Stock service-console access, no exploit used |

console_access.limit: This result applies to the tested stock console. It does not establish SSH access or a replacement firmware recovery path.

physical_pads.operator_words: the ground is the square one and then i think its TXD RXD

physical_pads.limit: The operator identified the square pad as ground. The order of TXD and RXD is tentative. No new electrical test was done.
